title: Practice permit PP-01 · Lot 1 family house
status: Practice — fictional alternative for learning; not an approval
approvedBy: User-approved practice brief (2026-10-20). Fictional; issued by no agency.

realPermit.note: The real conditional permit is unchanged. PP-01 is a study alternative used to learn how constraints shape a larger house; it does not modify, replace or interpret the real permit.

site.lot: Lot 1, Chazy Lake Road Subdivision 2024 (same lot boundary as the real permit)
site.lotAreaSource: Survey note on APA 2025-0137 page 9: 104,542.4 sq ft

household.summary: Two adults and two kids, living full-time.

program.location: Chosen by us inside the practice buildable region; not fixed

limits.label: Maximum height
limits.rule: Measured from the highest point of the structure to the lower of existing or finished grade (same definition as real condition 9).

limits.label: Maximum house footprint
limits.rule: House only; a detached garage is counted separately.

limits.label: Principal buildings
limits.rule: No more than 3 principal buildings on Lot 1 (real condition 17 already allows this); house + optional detached garage fit.

limits.label: Total clearing / disturbance
limits.rule: All vegetation removal and ground disturbance combined, including driveway, house, garage, septic and well.

limits.label: Road frontage setback
limits.rule: From each road frontage line (Garmish Street and Chazy Lake Road).

limits.label: Side / rear setback
limits.rule: From every Lot 1 line that is not road frontage.

limits.label: Wetland setback
limits.rule: From the survey wetland flag line. Applied to the closed survey wetland polygon, including its stream-side edge (see assumptions).

limits.label: Septic design basis
limits.rule: 3 bedrooms + office counted as a potential bedroom (practice assumption).

retainedConditions.text: Outdoor lights use full cut-off, fully shielded fixtures directed downward, not toward the sky, roads or neighbours.
Exterior roof, siding and trim are a dark shade of green, grey or brown.
No more than three principal buildings on Lot 1.

septicBasis.status: Practice sizing assumption — verify against NY 10 NYCRR Appendix 75-A and a NYS design professional
septicBasis.layout: 4 shallow trenches × 46 ft, 6 ft centre-to-centre → absorption field ≈ 20 × 50 ft
septicBasis.replacement: Replacement in the same footprint after removal of material, following the C1 note; no separate 100% reserve area modelled
septicBasis.placement: Over the C1 deep-hole / percolation test location, extending the C1 fill area north and east (away from the stream).
septicBasis.soil: Real C1 test pit (APA, 2025-07-14): usable soil 25 in, mottling at 25 in, stabilized perc 4 min/in at 6 in depth → shallow trenches with fill; no basement.

assumptions: The office is counted as a fourth bedroom for septic sizing.
Design flow 110 gpd per bedroom (water-saving fixtures) and application rate 1.20 gpd/sq ft for a 1–5 min/in percolation rate.
No basement: seasonal high groundwater indicated by mottling at 25 in.

The 100 ft wetland setback is measured from the closed survey wetland polygon (flag line plus the stream on its south-east side), because the survey shows no flags south-east of the stream and a 100 ft absorption-field-to-stream separation also applies.
Practice well stays at the C1 proposed well location.
The driveway is re-routed off the septic reserve (C1 already requires a shift away from the absorption field).
toVerify: Septic flow, application rate, trench length and spacing, tank size and separation distances against the current NY 10 NYCRR Appendix 75-A tables.
Whether a 4-bedroom shallow-trench system fits with 25 in of usable soil, or needs a raised / fill system.
Well-to-tank, tank-to-stream and field-to-wetland separations (75-A separation-distance table).
Whether a septic reserve or replacement area is required beyond in-place replacement.
Garage and driveway placement inside the 0.75 acre clearing cap.
Survey control: every practice polygon sits on a provisional county-GIS display fit (RMS 3.1 m).
